author: GameTrailers
description: Get a first look at the Holiday Drop! It adds Ice Caves, a new cave biome with icicles, light-emitting ice crystals, calcite, and a frozen zombie variant that deals a freezing effect – some throw ice balls. Brr! The Ice Caves Holiday Drop is coming later this year.
title: Minecraft - Official The Ice Caves Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get ready for Minecraft: Dungeons 2! Check out this brand-new trailer and get ready to return to the world of Minecraft Dungeons in an all-new adventure, brimming with high-stakes encounters, thrilling challenges, and never-before-seen locations. You defeated Arch-Illager in the first game, so this should be a walk in the park, right? A brand-new dimension: The Sift, missions that focus on your own exploration, and the angriest Illagers you’ve ever seen are just some things you can expect from Minecraft Dungeons 2! Minecraft Dungeons 2 is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox Cloud and Steam).
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Get Ready Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Screen Saver, a simulation management game developed by Distinguished Games. Explore an old operating system in this incremental game about desktop software that pays its users. Type stories, earn money, upgrade your software, and unlock new programs. Screen Saver is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Screen Saver - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the release date trailer for Topdeck Automat, a unique roguelike auto-battler, developed by 
Ludokultur. In a dark future, alien forces invaded Earth, seized control, and destroyed all of humanity's means of resistance. However, the seemingly harmless worker droids were spared: office assistants, flyer printers, vending machines, and the like. Hacked and reprogrammed for combat, they now march to take back the planet. You are one of them! Topdeck Automat will be available on PC (Steam) on November 16, 2026.
title: Topdeck Automat - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for Shuffle and Seek, is a 2-4 player party game of memory and mischief developed by Groovy Zebra Studio. Players will split into two teams: one secretly rearranges everything in the room, and the other tries to figure out exactly what changed. Shuffle the room before the clock runs out and figure out exactly what the Shufflers changed. Shuffle and Seek is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Shuffle and Seek - Official Launch Trailer
